description: A PHP Trait named PermissionTrait within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, providing a method to set permissions for an employee by interacting with a user role management helper and ensuring it is used within an AbstractVueController context.

methods.name: setPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Sets permissions for an employee by retrieving the permission collection for given data groups and employee number, then setting these permissions in the controller's context. It ensures the trait is used within an AbstractVueController instance.
